name: EgoDex
summary: 第一人称操作视频与逐帧头部、手部和上身三维位姿配对。
summaryEn: Egocentric manipulation videos paired with per-frame head, hand and upper-body poses.
access: Official documentation provides data access instructions; download not tested
accessZh: 官方文档提供数据访问说明；未实测下载
license: Dataset under CC BY-NC-ND terms; separate code license
licenseZh: 数据采用 CC BY-NC-ND 条款；代码另有许可
wmNote: 位姿由 ARKit 估计，置信度与语言标注可能有误差；人体轨迹不等于机器人控制。
wmNoteEn: ARKit poses and automated language annotations can contain errors; human trajectories are not robot controls.

evidence.statement: Paired MP4/HDF5 files align each video frame with joint and camera transforms in an episode-fixed coordinate frame. The release includes metrics for dexterous trajectory prediction.
